data: Does the F-measure consistently decrease as the threshold increases?

The F-measure is represented by the green line in the graph. The x-axis represents different thresholds, ranging from 0.3 to 0.7. The y-axis represents the values of precision, recall, and F-measure.

To determine if the F-measure consistently decreases as the threshold increases, I will analyze the trend of the green line across all three graphs:

1. In the first graph, the F-measure starts at approximately 0.7 and decreases to around 0.5 as the threshold increases from 0.3 to 0.7.
2. In the second graph, the F-measure starts at approximately 0.8 and decreases to around 0.6 as the threshold increases from 0.3 to 0.7.
3. In the third graph, the F-measure starts at approximately 0.8 and decreases to around 0.5 as the threshold increases from 0.3 to 0.7.

In all three graphs, the F-measure shows a decreasing trend as the threshold increases. Therefore, the F-measure consistently decreases as the threshold increases.
